statements.status_notes: CVE-2011-3389 is BEAST, the 2011 chosen-plaintext attack against CBC cipher suites in TLS 1.0. The issue is disputed by the GnuTLS maintainer and Debian has shipped no fix since 2011 (no fixed version exists). In this image libgnutls30 is dead weight: a DT_NEEDED scan of every ELF object in the built image finds exactly one consumer, librtmp.so.1, which is itself only reachable through libcurl's RTMP(S) protocol support, and no shipped component issues rtmp:// or rtmps:// transfers (zero rtmp scheme strings in the two libcurl consumers, librdkafka and the IBM DB2 clidriver GSKit library). Exploiting BEAST additionally requires an attacker who can inject adaptive chosen plaintext into a victim TLS 1.0 CBC session, a browser-style cross-origin oracle that a one-shot metadata-ingestion CLI does not provide.
